text: 0 of 10 bosses are safe to leave half-fought.
detail: A boss that SAVES damage between visits should be chipped at whenever you pass; one that RESETS when you leave must never be started unless it can be finished. Opposite rules, and the flag separating them is unverified for every boss, so all of them are treated as resetting. That forgoes an optimisation if wrong; the reverse would waste whole fights.
